name: Now
what: The place Now shows each run on one line: what it runs, since when, whether it is working, waiting on the model, waiting on a command, idle or stuck, and what it has spent. The line comes from the record, and its state is shown as the opinion of a classifier that ships with Silo. Subagents show as a tree.

suggest.why: It is the one place that shows every run of every computer at once, whichever agent program started it.
